name: RAGE QUIT OBBY 2
desc:
👋 Welcome to The Rage Quit Obby 2!

😡 This obby may look easy at first, but will progressively get harder until you RAGE-QUIT!

✅ All stages are possible, but only 0.1% of players beat the game!

🏅 Collect MEDALS to buy cool cosmetics! You can earn medals by playing through the obby and rebirthing!

👍 Please leave a like on the game and favorite to help support us!
